subject: [PATCH v2] mm/percpu: clean up callers of pcpu_obj_full_size()

reviews.author: Harry Yoo
reviews.summary: The reviewer noted that the patch does not address all callers of pcpu_obj_full_size() and requested further cleanup.
reviews.raw_body:
Looks good to me,
Reviewed-by: Harry Yoo (Meta) <harry@kernel.org>

Thanks!

-- 
Cheers,
Harry / Hyeonggon

2026-10-21.patch_summary: This patch refactors the callers of pcpu_obj_full_size() to make it clear that they are using the full size of a per-cpu allocation, including overhead. The function parameter is renamed from 'size' to 'full_size' in these calls. This change does not introduce any functional changes and only improves code clarity.
